issues.detail: The Greek 'ειρηκεν γαρ που περι της εβδομης' translates to 'For it is written concerning the Sabbath', but the Vietnamese 'có chỗ nào đó nói về' (there is a place that says) changes the source of the authority from a specific scriptural citation ('it is written') to a vague existence of a statement.
The Greek 'ουτως' (thus/in this way) is omitted in the Vietnamese translation.
